accessibility_effect: PRESENT AND LARGE. Same-probe modular-degree difference of +0.52 to +2.41, 24 to 108 times the estimator noise, persisting at identical phenotype and identical fitness in 12 of 12 run pairs at generations 2000 and 3000.
acquisition_link: ABSENT. Current best fitness predicted subsequent acquisition gain at Spearman rho -1.000 over generations 100 to 500 and -0.686 to -0.987 over 50 to 200, matching or beating every accessibility statistic. avgfit, the historical positive control, also matched or beat the modular degree.
why_it_is_a_background_not_a_particle: the accessibility difference is real, robust and well resolved, and adds no independent predictive value for acquisition beyond a free measurement
note: This is the programme's first entry in the background column and it is our own experiment. A collider needs backgrounds.

source: AI Safety Camp 2022, 'Project Intro: Selection Theorems for Modularity', reimplementing Kashtan and Alon 2005
accessibility_effect: NOT EVEN THE BASE EFFECT. The team's modularity measure never differentiated fixed-goal from modularly-varying-goal networks: 'non-modular messes both for fixed goals and Modularly Varying Goals across a wide range of experimental parameters'.
why_it_is_a_background: the whole MVG line is a load-bearing prior for the idea that history organises machinery differently, and one documented open replication attempt failed to reproduce its headline effect. The authors did not resolve whether their setup was inadequate or the original does not generalise.
note: This is a caveat on the entire MVG evidence base and it must travel with any citation of Kashtan and Alon in this programme.

source: Weinberger 1990 correlation length, as tested by Newman and Engelhardt 1998 and reported in Smith, Husbands and O'Shea 2002
accessibility_effect: INVERTED CASE. Added landscape neutrality demonstrably speeds up search while leaving the correlation-length statistic unchanged.
acquisition_link: the acquisition effect is real; the DETECTOR cannot see it
why_it_is_a_background: a documented instance of an accessibility-adjacent instrument being blind to a real effect on acquisition. The mirror image of our own K7, where the detector saw a real difference that did not matter. Both failure directions are now on record.
evidence_tier: HCR01_LANE_FULL_TEXT for Smith et al 2002, which reproduces the Weinberger method and the Newman and Engelhardt result
note: Together with K7 this defines the two ways a detector can be useless: it can miss what matters, or it can see what does not.

source: Four independent lines: Baeck self-adaptive GA (mutation rate in the genome); Altenberg 1994 constructional selection in GP; Spector 2001 autoconstructive evolution (Pushpop); mutator alleles in biology and in Avida
accessibility_effect: PRESENT. In all four, the way future variation is generated demonstrably changes over a run.
why_it_is_a_background: IN NONE OF THEM IS ANY ESTIMATE COMPUTED OR CONSULTED. Altenberg is explicit in his own words: 'the constructional fitness is never evaluated by the GP algorithm, nor is it obtained by averaging current program fitnesses'. Spector reports the population's reproductive strategy drifting from sexual to asexual over a run under ordinary selection with no controller present.
kill_condition: a standing warning rather than a kill condition
evidence_tier: HCR01_LANE_FULL_TEXT for Altenberg 1994 and Spector 2001; ABSTRACT_ONLY for the other two
note: THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT WARNING THE PASS PRODUCED. Observing that variational behaviour changed over a run is NOT evidence of a controller, and four independent substrates prove it. Any future Part-C claim must exhibit the estimate and the pathway, not the outcome.
